user.title: Connect Orchestra of Lights hub
user.description: Enter the IPv4 address of your OOL hub. The hub is only queried for its paired-device list.

import.title: Import your OOL Studio devices
import.description: In OOL Studio V6, click EXPORT HA SETTINGS. Open the exported ool_ha_devices.json file in Notepad, copy everything, and paste it below. Your private device list is stored in Home Assistant, not published to GitHub.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the hub. Verify the IP and that the hub is online.
error.invalid_settings: Invalid JSON or missing device IDs. Paste the complete OOL Studio export.

abort.already_configured: This OOL hub is already configured.
